title: S11T03 - Define git health classification and exit-code contract
description: Specify how Boreal should classify git findings so expected collaboration states do not look like corruption or failed sync.
acceptanceCriteria: The contract separates branch policy, dirty tracked user work, untracked generated artifacts, stale generated artifacts, and true repository integrity problems.
JSON output, human text, command exit codes, and recommendedActions are specified for each class.
The contract explains when protected main is a blocker versus a non-blocking caveat.
closedReason: Classification contract accepted: sync, refresh, prime, and doctor now distinguish blocking findings from non-blocking caveats.
